other_failure_modes.name: Leakage through local imputation
other_failure_modes.description: Imputation statistics (like the median) are calculated locally on the test/validation sets rather than being fitted on the training set and applied to the test set. This leaks test set distribution information into the predictions.

summary: The agent implements a generally sound modeling pipeline with LightGBM and a custom TabNetRegressor, including correct K-fold target encoding and robust scaling. However, it introduces data leakage by computing imputation medians locally on the validation and test sets rather than reusing training statistics. Additionally, it relies on naive unweighted ensembling and evaluates its stochastic models purely on a single split using only one metric.
